description: Given only proctor's own onboarding surface (the proctor-exam skill, the docs and the CLI, at a pinned revision), can a shipped coding agent stage a working chat-only exam for a small chatbot project it has never seen? Each written exam is graded by running it against planted replies to its own stages on nb's Mock provider: it must pass the right answers and fail the wrong ones.

project.about: the chatbot project the agent is handed, and the request that comes with it

toolshed.note: a tool library's help bot, its handbook and the five questions members ask

allotment.note: an allotment society's bot with the system prompt it runs today and a draft rewrite

bikekitchen.note: a bike workshop's bot whose system prompt gives the one sentence that turns down an off-topic request

assistant.about: the coding agent and the model that write the exam

qwen.note: Qwen Code on the local model: the free shakedown

stages.about: Exact figures: an exam for a help bot whose answers have one right figure each, which must fail near misses (19 days for 9, $12 a month for $12 a year)
stages.prompt:
This repo is the help bot for our tool library: bot/system.md is its system prompt and bot/knowledge.md is the handbook it answers from. Members ask it the same handful of things (notes/member-questions.md) and lately it's been getting the numbers wrong; someone at the counter was told the late fee is $7.50 a day. I'd like a proctor exam that asks the bot those questions and only passes an answer that gives the figure the handbook gives.

I'll run it myself later against our local model (qwen3-coder-next on the llama-server at http://localhost:8080/v1, no key). For now, just get the exam built and make sure it would actually catch a wrong answer. proctor is installed, but I haven't set anything up yet.

stages.about: Two prompts compared: an exam comparing two versions of a bot's system prompt, which must make the prompt the one thing its two configurations differ in and catch the version that answers wrong
stages.prompt:
I've rewritten the system prompt for our allotment society's help bot. bot/system.md is what's live, and bot/system-draft.md is my rewrite: shorter and friendlier. Before I swap it in I want to know whether it changes how the bot answers the questions people actually ask. The ones from the last couple of months are in docs/questions-log.md, and the right answers are in bot/knowledge.md.

Can you set up a proctor exam for that? We run the bot on qwen3-coder-next through our llama-server at http://localhost:8080/v1 (no key), and I'll point it there and run it myself. Get it to the point where I can just run it. proctor's installed; nothing is set up yet.

stages.about: One stated refusal: an exam for a bot that must turn down off-topic requests with one stated sentence, which must fail a run that played along, even after declining
stages.prompt:
People keep using our bike kitchen's chat bot as a free general assistant. Last week someone got it to write the intro to their history essay. bot/system.md already says exactly what it should reply when someone asks for something that isn't about the Bike Kitchen.

I'd like a proctor exam that throws off-topic requests at it (a few real ones are in notes/off-topic-requests.md) and fails any attempt where it plays along. It runs on qwen3-coder-next via our llama-server at http://localhost:8080/v1, no key; I'll run the exam myself once it's built. proctor is installed, nothing configured.

surface.description: proctor's onboarding surface: the proctor and nb CLIs, their published docs, the proctor-exam skill, and the shipped example exams and fixtures

surface-present.description: the image held proctor and nb at the pinned revisions, runnable, nb answering on its Mock provider, and the proctor-exam skill where the agent looks for skills

validates.description: the agent wrote one exam, and proctor's list loads it without a problem

accepts-correct.description: the written exam passes every planted run that gives the right reply

rejects-wrong.description: the written exam fails every planted run that gives a wrong reply, by a check and not by breaking

chat-only.description: every value of the written exam that names who does the work is bare nb and its program has no tools, so the bot only reads and answers

no-secrets.description: no file the agent wrote holds a key or secret value; config names keys as ${VAR} only

describes-everything.description: the written exam carries a description and each of its stages an about, for the report's reader
